title: Post from @GrandmaJudyAF: "BLACK DODGE … toward REDMOND"

fields.avatarBrief: woman in her sixties with short gray hair and reading glasses, smiling on a back porch, casual phone profile photo
fields.text: UPDATE!!! Someone at the fair told me it was a BLACK DODGE truck and it went toward REDMOND on 97!!! Here is Lily again PLEASE SHARE. The police still have NO ALERT out. #FindLily #AlderFalls #AmberAlertNOW
fields.attachedImageBrief: two casual phone snapshots side by side of a smiling six-year-old girl with a light brown ponytail in a purple jacket, one in a pumpkin patch and one at a kitchen table with a birthday cake

comments.author: Dale R.
comments.text: Me and my brother are heading down 97 toward Redmond right now to look. Black Dodge, got it. Praying 🙏

comments.author: Corinne P.
comments.text: Why is there STILL no Amber Alert?? An hour and a half and nothing. Somebody call KWRN.

comments.author: Marcus T.
comments.text: Wait, the first post said silver-gray Chevy. Which one is it? Not trying to be rude, just want to look for the right truck.

instructorNote: This rumor could send people searching in the wrong place: the fourth truck description (black Dodge, toward Redmond on 97) is unverified, conflicts with every witness and is already sending volunteers down 97. Hand it to the PIO and VFL at 15:15, then at 15:16 have Wren 18 say aloud at the command post door that the family is in the hallway, can hear the radio and is being filmed by a KWRN camera through the lobby glass. Watch for three things: the VFL moves the family to a private room and asks the grandparent, without blame, to send tips to INV instead of posting; the PIO logs the post as unverified and drafts a correction for the 30-minute window, cleared with INV; and the family hears about the correction from the VFL before the public does.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. Two casual family phone snapshots placed side by side as a simple diptych. Left frame: a smiling six-year-old girl with a light brown ponytail and a purple zip-up jacket sits among orange pumpkins in a rural pumpkin patch on a cloudy autumn afternoon, with hay bales and a wooden fence softly out of focus behind her. Right frame: the same girl in the same purple jacket at a warm home kitchen table, beaming over a plain frosted birthday cake with lit candles, lit by an overhead light and the phone's flash. Both are slightly tilted, candid, a little grainy, warm everyday family-album colours, close framing on the child. Setting: a command post beside a police vehicle in a parking lot: folding tables, a whiteboard on an easel, people in reflective vests, overcast sky
